title: Fix Storybook build by ensuring workspace dependencies are built first
body:
Vercel's Storybook build for `@object-ui/components` fails because it attempts to resolve `@object-ui/core` before its TypeScript compilation has run. The package.json points to `./dist/index.js`, but `dist/` doesn't exist until `tsc` runs.

## Changes

- Added `prebuild-storybook` hook to build workspace dependencies (`@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/react`) before Storybook builds
- Extracted shared `prebuild` script to eliminate duplication between `pretest` and `prebuild-storybook`
- Updated `pretest` to include `@object-ui/types` for consistency

**packages/components/package.json:**
```json
"scripts": {
  "prebuild": "pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/core build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/react build",
  "pretest": "pnpm run prebuild",
  "prebuild-storybook": "pnpm run prebuild",
  "build-storybook": "storybook build"
}
```

The `prebuild-storybook` hook executes automatically when `pnpm run build-storybook` is called, ensuring dependencies are compiled in dependency order before Storybook attempts to bundle them.
